sql.if: AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}), LOWER(permission_code)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}), LOWER(COALESCE(name, ''))) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}), LOWER(COALESCE(description, ''))) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}), LOWER(COALESCE(resource_type, ''))) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}), LOWER(COALESCE(action, ''))) > 0)

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_permission WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY permission_code ASC LIMIT #{pageable.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageable.offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_permission (permission_code, name, description, resource_type, action, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{permissionCode}, #{name}, #{description}, #{resourceType}, #{action}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_permission SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, resource_type = #{resourceType}, action = #{action}, enabled = #{enabled}, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE permission_code = #{permissionCode}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_permission WHERE permission_code = #{id})
